answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake before posting, so spawning a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand stakes. Each identity must also build a public history thread of completed work that peers can audit, and identities with no history earn nothing. A shared lagoon of pooled stakes slashes repeat offenders: if one agent signs two conflicting transactions, part of its stake is burned. Crossing this canyon of cost, stake, time, and reputation, makes forgery unprofitable, while honest agents get their stake back.
